CRT-632.summary: Support FX_SPOT in the widgets 'Search', 'Watchlist' and on the 'Instrument' page
CRT-632.description:
*Context*

New instrument type FX_SPOT should be available in the Adaptive widgets: 'Search', 'Recently Viewed', 'Watchlist' and on the 'Instrument' page. 

*Acceptance criteria*

*'Search' widget:*

Given the User opens the 'Search' widget
When the User searches for FX_SPOT instruments
Then search rules [DXINV-174|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/DXINV-174] and [DXINV-CB-206|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/DXINV-CB-206] are applied.
 
Given the User enters the Adaptive
When the User opens the 'Search' widget
Then the User is able to apply filters by OPOL and currency.

Given the User enters the Adaptive
When the User opens the 'Search' tab
Then the User sees 'FX SPOT' tab among other filter tabs 
And can search by FX_SPOT specifically.

Given the User opens the 'Search' widget
When the User performs search
Then FX_SPOT instruments are included in the results in the 'All' tab.

 
Given the User opens the 'Search' widget
When the User searches for FX_SPOT instruments
Then the User sees the FX_SPOT result cards 
And by clicking is redirected to the 'Instrument' page.

*'Recently Viewed' widget:*

Given the User has viewed the FX_SPOT Instrument page recently
When the User enters the 'Search' tab
Then the FX_SPOT instrument is present in the 'Recently Viewed' list.

*'Watchlist' widget:*

Given the User opens the Adaptive
When the User enters the 'Watchlist' tab
Then the User sees FX_SPOT card in the watchlists
And by clicking is redirected to the 'Instrument' page. 

*'Instrument' page:*
Given the User clicks the FX_SPOT card/link
When the User is on the FX_SPOT 'Instrument' page 
Then the User sees the following widgets:

Simple Chart based on midpoint,
'Instrument Info' similar to other instruments
'Stats' similar to CFD instruments.
(other widgets of the page display no data)

 

*Requirements*

1. *'Search' widget:*
 * Search rules [DXINV-174|https://confluence.in.d

CRT-639.summary: Cash Settlement based on Average Price
CRT-639.description:
h2. Business Context

This ticket is to change the way of PL calculation for FX Spot instruments from FIFO to avg.price.
h2. Requirements:
 # Introduce new setting to distinguish instrument types that are calculated by FIFO and by average price (associated data): [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1741] 
 # Average position fill price should be calculated based on the configuration: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1740] 
 # Open PL should be calculated based on the configuration: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1743] 
 # % PL Gross should be calculated based on configuration: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1742] 
 # Calculation by the weighted average for avg.position fill price, Open PL and *Realized PL* should be according to the following logic: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1738]
